title: Step-Up Blocks on Convex Barrier Liability Notices, Ostomy Supply Program
content:
**Clinical supply guideline - Ostomy Supply Program.** The step-up blocks on an Ostomy Supply Program liability notice for convex barriers (A4407) are taken off the 30-day blocks the excess is counted for after the newest written order raised the quantity.

| Newest written order for the convex barrier signed | Blocks taken off |
|---|---|
| 60 days or fewer ago | One block |
| More than 60 and at most 120 days ago | Half a block (0.5 block) |
| More than 120 days ago, or no written order | None |

Age is counted in calendar days from the newest written order's order date to today.

**Boundaries (hypothetical, excess of 6 per 30 days, 3 blocks).** Order signed 60 days ago: 6 multiplied by 2 blocks is 12. Signed 61 days ago: 6 multiplied by 2.5 blocks is 15. Signed 120 days ago: 15. Signed 121 days ago: 6 multiplied by 3 is 18.
